description: Compare current offers for one chosen product across US stores, ranked by price (item plus shipping where the store lists it, tax excluded). Use this at the buy step: the user asks where to buy it, what it costs at different stores, whether a price or sale is a good deal, if it's cheaper somewhere else, or for the link; pass a product_id from search_products. Returns the top 3 offers by default (detail=true for up to 8) and a status that says plainly when no offers exist, so never guess a price. Each offer links to its divux page, where the user picks a store. Official CPSC recall notices that mention the product are included only when there are some; their absence is not a safety check (use check_recalls for that). Do not use to buy or check out.

condition.description: new (default) unless the user asks for used, open-box or refurbished; 'used' covers all of those; 'any' shows everything.

detail.description: false: top 3 offers (default, best for chat and voice). true: up to 8.

name: compare_prices

design.description: Present when this offer is for another design or color of the product (match 'variant'): that listing's own title

shipping.description: null when the store's shipping cost isn't known; total is then the item price

returns.description: The store's return window for this kind of item, from its official policy

warning.description: Present when divux doubts this offer's data, e.g. a 'new' price that looks like open-box; relay it to the user

price_scope.description: What the prices are: each store's online price for delivery in the US, not local in-store prices

designs.description: Every design or color combined into this product, when there are several

recalls.description: Only present when official recall notices mention this product

specs.description: Key features and attributes from the product data, for comparing products; divux doesn't judge them

spoken.description: One sentence to say aloud on voice devices; details stay on the link

title: Shopper: compare prices
